# Email: Marketing

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the direct marketing email extension for Caffeine AI apps: subscriber management by topic, per-recipient personalization (`{{NAME}}` substitutions), and mandatory unsubscribe links — the whole consent-aware stack in one skill. Recipients must be verified and subscribed to the topic before any send; every mail carries a per-recipient `{{UNSUBSCRIBE_URL}}` the system resolves automatically. Depends on `caffeinelabs-extension-email-verification` and `caffeinelabs-extension-email`. Requires a Caffeine AI Plus or Pro subscription — there is no free tier for this skill. Honest caveats: works only inside a Caffeine AI build (Internet Computer canister + Motoko); subscriber state must be managed solely through the provided modules, not duplicated on user profiles; check your jurisdiction's email marketing rules — the skill gives you the mechanics, not legal advice.
